purpose: Negative space for Whole Life — America. Every domain must appear as live/seed/stub/missing/deferred.
formula: Life coverage = geometric_mean(breadth, depth, currency, connectivity, agency) × 100

domains.name: Identity
domains.includes: legal identity, DOB, SSN refs, citizenship, names, signatures, biometrics
domains.notes: No identity Prim. Name fragments only inside person packs.

domains.name: Government credentials
domains.includes: passport, DL, voter reg, permits, TSA/Global Entry
domains.notes: No packs, no connector, no deferred stub before this file.

domains.name: Family
domains.includes: parents, siblings, children, spouses, extended family, kinship graph, family history
domains.notes: Some person packs with relationship prose; links[] incubating, not stamped; no family history Prim.

domains.name: Friends & social relationships
domains.includes: friendships, history, closeness, introductions, social circles
domains.notes: Contact shells exist; no closeness/history graph.

domains.name: Professional relationships
domains.includes: coworkers, partners, clients, vendors, advisors, investors
domains.notes: Many people packs with work notes; not a graph of roles over time.

domains.name: Home
domains.includes: residences, leases/mortgages, rooms, furnishings, repairs, keys, access
domains.notes: Address known to agents in memory, not as a Prim tree.

domains.name: Property & real estate
domains.includes: owned properties, deeds, valuations, improvements, taxes, interests
domains.notes: 239 Eagle / Creekside exist as agent work, not filed life packs here.

domains.name: Utilities & household services
domains.includes: electric, water, gas, internet, trash, security, landscaping
domains.notes: Explicit gap. Bill→house→card→HVAC chain does not exist.

domains.name: Money
domains.includes: banking, cash, cards, brokerage, retirement, net worth, transfers
domains.notes: Large opff/tx dumps; receive not in-host; not a usable net-worth model.

domains.name: Income
domains.includes: salary, businesses, distributions, investments, royalties, reimbursements
domains.notes: Fragments in money dumps; no income Prim.

domains.name: Debt & obligations
domains.includes: mortgages, cards, loans, guarantees, recurring commitments
domains.notes: Creekside loan is agent-owned, not a life Prim index.

domains.name: Taxes
domains.includes: federal, state, property, business, filings, supporting records
domains.notes: No tax year packs.

domains.name: Insurance
domains.includes: health, auto, property, liability, life, umbrella, claims
domains.notes: No insurance Prim.

domains.name: Work & career
domains.includes: employers, positions, accomplishments, compensation, reviews, career narrative
domains.notes: AIC/Boone/Eidos heavily represented in people + meetings; not a career Prim.

domains.name: Businesses & entities
domains.includes: companies, ownership, governance, contracts, employees, IP
domains.notes: Company profiles exist (eidos-agi, aic-holdings, …) but thin; ocsf/entity depth unclear in inbox.

domains.name: Health & care
domains.includes: clinicians, visits, diagnoses, medications, labs, imaging, allergies, insurance
domains.notes: ohf/ophf dirs with few packs; not a care graph.

domains.name: Body & fitness
domains.includes: activity, sleep, weight, exercise, biometrics, capabilities
domains.notes: aad exists as CLI elsewhere; not filed as continuous life Prims here.

domains.name: Food & consumption
domains.includes: groceries, restaurants, preferences, nutrition
domains.notes: Not modeled.

domains.name: Transportation
domains.includes: vehicles, registrations, maintenance, insurance, fuel, rideshare, transit
domains.notes: ovf seeds ≠ mature vehicle (VIN, insurance, maintenance, drivers, …).

domains.name: Travel & places
domains.includes: trips, reservations, flights, hotels, places visited, favorites, history
domains.notes: Calendar hints only.

domains.name: Communications
domains.includes: email, SMS, iMessage, calls, voicemail, Slack/Teams, correspondence
domains.notes: iMessage receive live; thread index stubby; mail missing.

domains.name: Calendar & lived time
domains.includes: appointments, events, meetings, birthdays, routines, what actually happened
domains.notes: Many calendar-event + omf packs; receive not in-host; thin 'what happened'.

domains.name: Tasks & responsibilities
domains.includes: commitments, errands, chores, recurring obligations, promises
domains.notes: otf=1; no tasks connector citing docket.

domains.name: Possessions
domains.includes: objects, electronics, furniture, clothing, warranties, receipts, serials
domains.notes: photo/scan dumps ≠ possession registry.

domains.name: Digital life
domains.includes: accounts, devices, domains, software, subscriptions, online identities, auth
domains.notes: Unusually strong via work/AI/repos; not a unified digital-life Prim index.

domains.name: Knowledge & learning
domains.includes: education, books, courses, skills, notes, research
domains.notes: Research/AI depth high; personal education/skills packs thin.

domains.name: Media & culture
domains.includes: music, movies, shows, games, podcasts, art, tastes
domains.notes: album viewer exists in product; personal culture history not filed.

domains.name: Community, civic & institutional life
domains.includes: clubs, churches/groups, schools, charities, memberships, voting
domains.notes: Not modeled.

domains.name: Goals, values & inner life
domains.includes: ambitions, preferences, beliefs, decisions, fears, principles, questions, plans
domains.notes: emf seeds; not a continuous inner-life model.

domains.name: Legacy, legal & death
domains.includes: wills, trusts, POAs, beneficiaries, estate wishes, archives
domains.notes: Explicit gap. Highest-stakes empty domain.
